title: Fixed Assets
intro: Create a purchase order (payable), pay supplier (cash down — shows as fixed-asset receivable until received), then receive onto the balance sheet. You may also receive on credit first (payable stays until paid). Sell or write off updates cash and removes the asset from the books.

form.payImmediately: Pay immediately from cash (receive separately when the asset arrives)

payment.receiveExplain: Confirm that "{{name}}" has arrived. The asset becomes active. No money moves here.
payment.title: Payment

confirmWriteOff: Write off "{{name}}"? Remaining book value will be expensed.
confirmDelete: Remove purchase order for "{{name}}"? Payable will be cancelled.

notifications.received: Asset received onto the balance sheet.
notifications.enterPayment: Enter at least one payment amount.

importExcel.buttonHint: Add fixed assets from an Excel file
importExcel.intro: Download the template, fill it in and upload it here. Assets arrive as "ordered, not paid" — no cash leaves the till, and you pay for each one on this page afterwards.
importExcel.readFailed: The file could not be read.
importExcel.saveFailed: Saving failed, so nothing was saved.
importExcel.templateFailed: The template could not be downloaded.
importExcel.title: Fixed assets — import from Excel
